test_title: PYST 64: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: These structures have come to play an importent role.
These structres have come to play an important role.
These structures have come to play an important role
These strucures have come to play an important role.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"importent"** is incorrectly spelled and should be **"important"**. (महत्वपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** It is important to stay hydrated during the summer.
 
 
 
• The word **"structres"** is incorrectly spelled and should be **"structures"**. (संरचनाएं)
 
 
• **Example:** The ancient structures in Rome are fascinating.
 
 
 
• The word **"strucures"** is incorrectly spelled and should be **"structures"**. (संरचनाएं)
 
 
• **Example:** Modern structures are often made of steel and glass.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** These structures have come to play an importent role. (महत्वपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** It is importent to verify your work before submission. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** These structres have come to play an important role. (संरचनाएं)
 
 
• **Example:** These structres are vital for the building’s stability. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** These strucures have come to play an important role. (संरचनाएं)
 
 
• **Example:** These strucures are designed to withstand earthquakes. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 

36:Tb89,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
